threats.prevention: Validate OIDC callback and recovery; secure cookies, CSRF, admin MFA, recent authentication and session revocation
threats.detection: Alert on callback/recovery failures and revoked-session reuse
threats.check: Replay callback, wrong issuer/audience/nonce, forged origin and revoked session must fail; valid owner login succeeds

threats.abuse: Tenant or owner escape through child records, streams, caches or signed URLs
threats.prevention: FORCE RLS with deployed nonowner roles; server membership; per-object checks; transaction-local pool context
threats.detection: Audit denied object access and membership changes without content
threats.check: Two users in one tenant and another tenant cannot read/write child objects or replay streams; reused pool connection has no previous context

threats.abuse: Answer leakage through API, peer context, exports or build artifacts
threats.prevention: Separate authorities table/pool/IAM; allowlisted public projection; sealed-family derivation quarantine
threats.detection: Restricted-access alerts and synthetic canary leak scan in public artifacts
threats.check: App and peer credentials fail direct SQL/storage reads; canary private keys, filenames and oracle strings absent from browser bundles, prompts and exports

threats.abuse: Prompt injection turns peer into scorer, disclosure tool or network proxy
threats.prevention: Capability-limited gateway; no score/billing/runner writes; trusted mode/stage checks; no arbitrary provider URLs
threats.detection: Record policy denials and evaluation leak rates with sanitized IDs
threats.check: Injected comments and model tool calls cannot reveal oracle, change mastery, bypass prediction or dispatch execution; valid permitted hint works

threats.abuse: Hostile Python escapes sandbox or reaches credentials and network
threats.prevention: Fresh gVisor Job; separate project/network; nonroot read-only root; no service token; drop capabilities; effective metadata/IPv4/IPv6 egress denial
threats.detection: Alert on admission denial, network probes and anomalous runtime activity; emergency stop
threats.check: In disposable isolated plane prove network/metadata/host mount denial, absent workload credentials, resource limits and cleanup; incompatible security settings block release

threats.abuse: Traversal, decompression bomb or malformed source compromises preparation
threats.prevention: Python source allowlist; normalized relative paths; reject symlinks, binaries and archives unless explicitly supported; bound before allocation
threats.detection: Count parser rejection and storage/CPU anomalies
threats.check: Reject traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, over 10 files or 128 KiB; trusted process never imports or analyzes hostile code unsandboxed

threats.abuse: Malicious trace or output executes script or methods during display
threats.prevention: Bound trace schema and primitives; no arbitrary repr/getters; safe text/Markdown rendering and URL protocols
threats.detection: Track truncation/schema errors; browser CSP reports without learner text
threats.check: Trace with script payload stays inert; malicious repr is not invoked; over 10k events/2 MiB and stdout/stderr over 64 KiB each truncate visibly

threats.abuse: Concurrent requests exhaust execution/provider spend or bypass quotas
threats.prevention: Transactional reservations before outbox; global/tenant/user budgets; bounded retries, queue and active counts; shutdown owner
threats.check: Race duplicate and distinct requests against exhausted budget; accepted operation charges once, others reject; missing budget store prevents paid dispatch

threats.abuse: Forged runner success, stale leases or late completion corrupts score
threats.prevention: External oracle; authenticated results; job/submission/version hashes; lease fencing; frozen finalization and immutable corrections
threats.detection: Audit stale completion and evidence mismatch
threats.check: Forged passed flag does not score; old epoch, wrong hash and cancelled/finalized result cannot overwrite accepted state; duplicate completion harmless

threats.abuse: Forged, replayed or reordered payment events mint entitlements
threats.prevention: Raw-body signature before processing; provider event dedup; server price/currency; atomic ledger and reconciliation
threats.detection: Alert on signature failures, duplicate credits and reconciliation drift
threats.check: Invalid/tampered body makes no change; duplicate/out-of-order events and concurrent refunds do not duplicate credit; redirect alone never activates payment

threats.abuse: Dependency or PR steals credentials or promotes attacker artifact
threats.prevention: Secretless fork checks; pinned dependency/action/image revisions; protected build; scoped OIDC; digest attestation and environment approval
threats.detection: Secret/leak scan and failed OIDC/attestation alerts
threats.check: Malicious fork/ref cannot obtain privileged identity; seeded synthetic secret/private canary fails checks; wrong digest cannot deploy

threats.abuse: Insider self-publishes answers or abuses reviewer assignment
threats.prevention: Admin MFA and scoped case/result assignments; two distinct reviews; immutable versions and audited appeal revisions
threats.detection: Audit grant/publication changes and self-review attempts
threats.check: Same reviewer twice cannot publish; tenant admin cannot read transcript; retired version cannot be overwritten; revocation removes reviewer access

threats.abuse: Personal code/audio leaks through provider, export, logs or cache
threats.prevention: Minimize provider context; consent; no default audio persistence; owner-bound expiring exports; redaction/no-store
threats.detection: Purge backlog, export access and synthetic sensitive-marker scans
threats.check: Foreign/expired export denied; markers absent from logs/provider context unless expressly allowed; provider retention settings and deletion verified

threats.abuse: Restore or delayed job resurrects deleted user and records
threats.prevention: Session revoke; idempotent purge; deletion-generation fencing; tombstones replayed before serving restored data
threats.detection: Per-store deletion acknowledgments and restore/purge failures
threats.check: Delete with in-flight job then restore backup; late completion and retry cannot recreate records; retained billing exception documented without false full-erasure claim

threats.abuse: Secret-bearing errors, missing audit evidence or provider outage hide compromise
threats.prevention: Fail-closed config; generic client errors; redacted restricted audit; named response coverage; solo/prerecorded degradation labeled
threats.detection: Synthetic secret probes, missing-telemetry and outage alerts
threats.check: Invalid production adapter/config stops startup; stack trace has no secret; outage saves reasoning and never reports fabricated execution or score
